# REST API Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > REST API

## Overview

Designs RESTful APIs with proper resource modeling, HTTP method usage, and URL conventions following REST architectural constraints

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rest-api-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rest-api-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rest-api-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design resource-oriented API endpoints
- Implement proper HTTP method semantics
- Create URL hierarchy for nested resources
- Design query parameters for filtering and pagination

## Technology Standards Applied

- **REST Principles**: RESTful API architectural constraints
- **HTTP Methods**: Proper use of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE
- **URL Design**: Resource URL naming conventions
